section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section reviews existing literature on the relationship between executive functions (Updating, Shifting, Inhibition) and creativity, noting contradictory findings and a lack of studies examining both the unity and diversity of EFs in creativity. The present study aims to address this gap by investigating how divergent thinking components (fluency and originality) relate to common and diverse EFs, and by examining the role of EFs in real-life creativity.
